upcoming_event_surface_label: Example upcoming-event page and pre-live countdown posture for official voter-information media routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews public upcoming-event pages, Premiere watch pages, waiting-room shells, and pre-live countdown surfaces so scheduled official media remains subordinate to the current written/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow current-answer page before the event begins.

reviewed_upcoming_event_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the public event shell can be shared or discovered before start and whether it stays visibly subordinate to the current written/help route.
Reviewed whether countdowns, trailers, recurring-schedule overlays, or before-event messages remain truthful during delay, reschedule, or pre-start drift.
Reviewed whether comments, chat, polls, or Q&A can appear before the media starts and whether those surfaces stay subordinate to the current written/help lane.
Reviewed whether shared or embedded pre-start variants still preserve practical recovery to the current official page or named help route.

upcoming_event_boundary_note: Upcoming-event pages and pre-live shells are treated as scheduling and discovery surfaces rather than automatic proof that the controlling operational answer already lives on the media page.
discoverability_note: If the pre-start shell can appear in search, recommendations, copied links, or embeds, the service records which shell state was actually reviewed rather than assuming the website path is the only first contact.
countdown_truthfulness_note: Countdowns, trailers, before-event messages, and waiting-room states are reviewed so visual imminence does not outrun the current written/help route.
interaction_boundary_note: If comments, chat, polls, or Q&A can appear before start, those interaction layers are treated as neighboring surfaces rather than proof that the shell itself is the office's settled help desk.
current_help_recovery_note: When a voter lands on an upcoming-event shell, the route still points back to the current official page, notice, FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of pretending that the pre-start media shell fully controls.
